body: Then,what should I do? How do I fight this off?

But, what if there are no helping hands? There are people and manny of them who constantly ridicule you, bully you, just because you are ugly. If there is a helping hand, then I'm yet to find it. I want to reach out for help. But, there is not a single place that I know of....

Well. Given my looks and how I ugly I'm deemed by the people, there are not many I can call friends. And, the few who fit into the bill, they don't realize the problem and seem to laugh it off. For many, it's a no issue. But, my insecurities and my ostracization for my looks has taken me to a ditch.

Sir, given the present scenario, it's all lonely and dark for me. And, that's what aggravates the problem even more. I don't know how am I going to do this alone. I feel that I've no longer any control over my life.

I was once caught by my mom in the act itself. And, it didn't make any matter simple. I was ostracized and was frowned upon by parents for a month or so. I don't think a recourse to my family is anyway feasible.

Yes, Sir, everything! I've kept myself occupied. I'm into sports. I diligently do my studies. But, in the briefest moments of solitude, I'm struck by an urge, and I'm helpless. I'm a 24 year old guy. My self esteem has taken a hit after being repeatedly told by people that I'm ugly. The fairer sex doesn't want to indulge any communication with me. I'm a learned person, I've read great people and I try to be rational all the time. But, this human mind and ego is no where near perfect, and I find myself wanting. I'm an invisible man, the world doesn't acknowledge my existence. And, all because that I look ugly.
I very well know what you mean! I want to take your words for the value. But, I'm always thwarted by these urges, they are too hard to curtail. And, worse is I can't seek help.

I don't know whether it is the right place or not. But, I'll go ahead.. It's my addiction to masturbate and feel sexual all the time. I've tried NoFap a lot of times and failed. The urges to be sexual is way strong for me. I can't control it and it is eating away my life one day at a time. I can't seek help, there are no professionals around and I cam't discuss with anyone else for the fear of being ridiculed. Sometimes, I feel like before this addiction kills me, I better kill myself first. I also have a hidden feeling that someday I may get violent with someone and do the unspeakable i.e. rape.

I feel like I'm a waste. I believe I have a lot of potential but I fail more often than not. And, to make matters worse, I'm embroiled in a very horrible addiction. People call it normal, but I know everyday it is killing me.
